argv: Walk notes (the owner's own walks steer the loop

ops.body: [owner] Walk notes: the place check reads names as written (specs/walk-notes, J1, WN4d). A town, region or country of the gazetteer written in lowercase, and a park, a station or a landmark with no gazetteer name in it, pass `scripts/walks.js`; they are left to `/walked`'s rewrite and the owner's look at the stored words. A word list or a stricter check would be a dependency or refuse plain words (GeoNames' towns include "of", "to" and "time").
[owner] Walk notes: "settled after three walks" (G8's "After it"): an area three walk notes in a row find nothing in the way of, read as settled; G6 computes the states it would join.
